FORM NO. 3
G. 40M-1-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
C.S.6, Special Branch. XXXXX Station,
REPORT
Date ____ July 6, 19 38.

SECRET

Subject (in full) Germany to secure Extraterritoriality - rumoured.

Made by ............ and ............ Forwarded by Inspector Papp.

It is strongly rumoured that Germany will soon
be granted extraterritorial rights in the Japanese occupied
areas of China. In this connection, it is stated, that the
successor of Mr. H.E.Oskar P. Trautmann, the German Ambassador
to China, who has recently been recalled, would not present
his credentials to the Nationalist Government, but will make
Shanghai his headquarters. The successor will most likely
represent Germany in the capacity of an Envoy Extraordinary.

As regards the other powers who relinquished their
extraterritorial rights, it has been learned, that they will
not follow the German lead in case the plans for the re-
establishment of extraterritorial rights for German subjects
should become an accomplished fact.

（左侧手写批注：C.S.6 / This para is / not clear to / me. 7/7）

E. Papp
Inspector

D.C. (Special Branch).

（左下角签名及标注：
〔此处转录不清〕
6/7
P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)
）

报告
日期 1938年7月6日。

秘密

事由（全称） 传闻德国将获取治外法权。

由 ____ 和 ____ 编制，由帕普（Papp）督察转呈。

有强烈传闻称，德国即将在中国被日军占领的地区获得治外法权。据此称，近期被召回的德国驻华大使陶德曼（H.E. Oskar P. Trautmann）先生的继任者，将不会向国民政府递交国书，而是以上海为总部。该继任者极有可能以特命全权公使的身份代表德国。

至于其他已放弃治外法权的列强，据悉，如果为德国臣民恢复治外法权的计划成为既成事实，它们也不会效仿德国的做法。

（左侧手写批注：C.S.6 / 此段 / 我不 / 清楚。 7/7）

E. 帕普（E. Papp）
督察
